keySentence: The wolf spoke in a kind voice.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The wolf smiled. He was not really kind. He had a bad plan. The wolf spoke in a kind voice.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The wolf was very sly and had a secret plan. He pretended to be nice to trick the little girl. The wolf spoke in a kind voice and asked about Grandmother. Red Riding Hood told him where the house was. The wolf grinned because now he knew the way. Poor Red Riding Hood did not know she was being tricked.
